summary.name: Static Site Generators
summary.one_liner: A large, unstructured table listing dozens of static site generator and blog-generator projects with their stars, license, language and dates, as found in the awesome-selfhosted list.
use_cases: pick a tool for building a blog from markdown
find open source static site generators by language
find static site tools for github pages
summary.what_it_does: This page is a single table of many static site generator and blog generator projects. Each row gives the project name and short description, GitHub star count, license, primary language, and created and updated dates. Languages covered include Python, Ruby, JavaScript, Rust, PHP, Perl, Go and others. Some rows are marked unmaintained or deprecated, and some are hosting services such as Bitbucket, GitLab and GitHub Pages. The page itself does not describe a single product.
notable: Lists dozens of static site generators with GitHub stars, license and language
Includes a mix of languages such as Python, Ruby, JavaScript, Rust and PHP
Flags several projects as unmaintained or deprecated
caveats: Page text is a raw data table with no descriptions for many entries, and it is truncated at the end
Entries are individual projects, not one tool; some listed projects are unmaintained or deprecated
Some rows are hosting services rather than generators
